label: Glide ground range in wind is at most h (L/D)max (1 + w/u)
statement_en: A steady glide from height h in an along-track wind w (positive tailwind) covers at most h (L/D)max (1 + w/u) over the ground; a longer claimed ground range is ruled out.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

non_vacuity_witness.statement: theorem windGlide_model_witness : ∃ u s h w x LDmax : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ 0 < s ∧ 0 ≤ h ∧ -u ≤ w ∧ u / s ≤ LDmax ∧ x = (u + w) * (h / s)

approval.basis: approved by the project lead in the hub session after review of sources and mutation results (relayed to the registry thread by the hub coordinator)

history.change: candidate -> accepted: human approval recorded (approved_by_role human:project-lead)

lean.source:
/-- A glide claimed to cover more ground than the wind-corrected bound is ruled out. -/
theorem wind_glide_rules_out {u s h w x LDmax : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hs : 0 < s) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hw : -u ≤ w)
    (hLD : u / s ≤ LDmax) (hx : x = (u + w) * (h / s)) (hbig : LDmax * h * (1 + w / u) < x) : False := by
  have := glide_ground_range_le hu hs hh hw hLD hx
  linarith

constraint_details.relation: x ≤ (L/D)max h (1 + w/u), w positive for a tailwind, w ≥ −u
constraint_details.canEliminate: a glide claiming more ground than its height, glide ratio and wind allow
